title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - ReferenceBorderPoint
description: Reference border point (era:ReferenceBorderPoint's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): List of reference border points that are specified in the RINF Application Guide. Inherits attributes from era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ReferenceBorderPoint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

borderPointId.description: Property. Border point identification in the list of reference border points in the RINF application guide.

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
